body.claim: In 1980, IBM's 3380 became the first hard drive to hold a gigabyte, and it weighed about 250 kg.
body.why: Storage has shrunk almost unimaginably. A modern phone holds hundreds of times that capacity in a few grams, and a microSD card holds far more than the 3380 did.

probes.question: True or false: the first gigabyte-sized hard drive (1980) weighed about 250 kg.
